guardrailNotes: Private Admin Review candidates only; this run does not accept, activate, publish, migrate, contact, commit or alter canonical organizations, capabilities, demand, relationships or media.

No candidate creates a Mission Area or Public Need match; later comparison remains a human-reviewed derived read without procurement eligibility, endorsement, customer interest or classified-demand inference.
